The team's colours are [[black]] and [[green]], which have earned them the nickname ''Neroverdi'' ("black and greens"). Sassuolo competes in [[Serie A]], the highest division in the [[Italian football league system]]. The club made its debut in Serie A during the [[2013–14 Serie A|2013–14 season]], becoming one of the few teams to compete in the top division without representing a [[Provinces of Italy|provincial]] capital.{{efn|[[Empoli FC|Empoli]], [[AC Legnano|Legnano]], [[Aurora Pro Patria 1919|Pro Patria]] ([[Busto Arsizio]]), [[AC Carpi|Carpi]], and [[Casale FBC|Casale]].{{cite web |date=17 November 2009 |title=Mimmo Carratelli racconta la finale scudetto col Savoia del 1924 |url=https://www.pianetagenoa1893.net/la-storia-del-genoa/mimmo-carratelli-racconta-la-finale-scudetto-col-savoia-del-1924/}}{{cite news |date=10 May 2013 |title=Non solo Sassuolo, quando la "provincia" arriva in Serie A |url=http://sport.sky.it/sport/calcio_italiano/2013/04/26/sassuolo_e_le_provinciali_alla_riscossa.html |access-date=6 December 2014 |work=[[Sky Italia]] |archive-date=13 December 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141213010737/http://sport.sky.it/sport/calcio_italiano/2013/04/26/sassuolo_e_le_provinciali_alla_riscossa.html |url-status=dead }}}} Sassuolo remained in Serie A until the [[2023–24 Serie A|2023–24 season]], when they were relegated to Serie B.
